e0149abb69d5a3fb34a9ed0664d9a061d7f62a89.definition: 最初に提示された価格や条件が、以降の提案や判断の基準となる現象。数字そのものが妥当かどうかとは別に、最初の一Laboratory値の影響を受ける。

e0149abb69d5a3fb34a9ed0664d9a061d7f62a89.definition: Referência inicial de preço ou proposta em uma negociação, que passa a balizar as ofertas seguintes. Quem apresenta o primeiro valor tende a inclinar a negociação a seu favor.
e0149abb69d5a3fb34a9ed0664d9a061d7f62a89.gloss: O primeiro número de uma negociação, contra o qual todos os números seguintes são medidos.

Penjual membuka dengan angka 120.000, dan setiap angka setelahnya diukur terhadap angka tersebut.
O vendedor abriu em 120 mil, e todas as cifras seguintes foram medidas contra esse anchoring.
판매자는 12만 원으로 시작했고 이후 모든 금액이 그 기준으로 비교되었다.
売り手は12万円から提示し、その後の数字はすべてそれを基準に判断された。

e0149abb69d5a3fb34a9ed0664d9a061d7f62a89.text: The seller opened at 120,000, and every figure after that was measured against it.

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.definition: The name of the pattern of three moves: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.
e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.gloss: The name of the pattern of three moves: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.definition: 「否認・攻撃・被害者と加害者の立場の反転」という三つの手順をまとめた呼称である。否定、攻撃、反転の順に現れることが多い。
e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.gloss: 否認、攻撃、加害者と被害者の立場の入れ替えの三つを指す呼び方。

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.definition: 문제를 부인하고, 문제를 제기한 사람을 공격한 뒤, 피해자와 가해자의 역할을 뒤집는 세 단계 대응 방식이다. 이 세 단계는 서로의 행동과 의도를 왜곡해 원래의 문제를 흐리는 데 초점을 둔다.
e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.gloss: 부인, 공격, 피해자와 가해자의 역할 뒤집기로 이루어진 세 단계 대응.

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.definition: Nome de um padrão de três movimentos: negar, atacar e inverter as posições de vítima e agressor. O termo é uma designação para essa sequência, não um diagnóstico.
e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.gloss: Padrão que combina negação, ataque e a inversão entre vítima e agressor.

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.definition: Istilah untuk pola yang menggabungkan penyangkalan terhadaprees alleged, serangan terhadap orang yang menuduh, dan pembalikan peran korban serta pelaku. Tujuannya adalah menggugurkan tanggung jawab atas tindakan yang dilakukan.
e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.gloss: Pola tiga langkah: menyangkal, menyerang, lalu membalik peran korban dan pelaku.

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.definition: รูปแบบการรับมือสามขั้นตอน ได้แก่ ปฏิเสธ โจมตี และกลับบทให้เหยื่อกับผู้กระทำ โดย DARVO เป็นชือย่อของแนวคิดนี้
e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.gloss: รูปแบบ DARVO ซึ่งเปลี่ยนผู้กระทำเป็นผู้ถูกกระทำ

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.definition: Bir olayı reddetme, karşıdakine saldırma ve ardından mağdur ile suçlu rollerini yer değiştirerek sorumluluğu aktarma örüntüsü. Kısaltması, bu üç adımı belirtir.
e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.gloss: Reddetme, saldırma ve mağdur ile suçlu rollerini tersine çevirme biçimindeki üç adımlı örüntü.

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.translation: Örüntü DARVO'ydu: reddetme, saldırma ve mağdur ile suçlu rollerini tersine çevirme.
รูปแบบนี้คือ DARVO เพราะเขาปฏิเสธข้อกล่าวหา โจมตีผู้อื่น แล้วกลับบทให้ตนเป็นผู้ถูกกระทำ
Pola itu disebut DARVO: menyangkal, menyerang, lalu membalik peran korban dan pelaku.
O padrão era DARVO: negar, atacar e inverter as posições de vítima e agressor.
그 패턴은 DARVO였다. 부인하고, 공격하고, 피해자와 가해자의 역할을 뒤집었다.
そのパターンはDARVOだった。否認、攻撃、そして被害者と加害者の反転だ。

e05da8571a60beb26aa6567fd4bb26669b5a847f.text: The pattern was DARVO: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.
